name: Infoblox — DHCP Starvation
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DHCP"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "DHCPDISCOVER"
| bin _time span = 5m
| comp count() as discovers by _time
| filter discovers >= 150
description: High volume of DHCPDISCOVER events — DHCP pool exhaustion attempt.
alert_description:
What fired: High volume of DHCPDISCOVER events — DHCP pool exhaustion attempt.

Why it matters: activity may degrade, deny, or destroy systems or data. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1498 - Network Denial of Service (TA0040 - Impact).

Investigate:
  - Identify the affected systems and the source/principal driving the volume.
  - Assess blast radius and whether service degradation, encryption, or deletion is actively occurring.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (_time) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
